note: DiagramSpec v1 is the preferred semantic input. The default renderer creates native editable PowerPoint shapes and connectors at /slide[N]/group[K]; explicit render=smartart creates persistent native SmartArt at /slide[N]/smartart[K] from the same semantic spec. Both preserve fact references and accept the shared Office brand theme. Mermaid remains a compatibility input adapter.

spec.description: Preferred input: path to DiagramSpec v1 JSON. It carries semantic nodes, edges and source-backed fact references, never OOXML or coordinates. Alias: diagramSpec.

themeFile.description: Optional path to the shared Office theme v1 JSON used for native diagram colors.

mermaid.description: Mermaid diagram source. Canonical (mirrors equation's 'formula'). Aliases: text, dsl. The first line's header (flowchart TD / sequenceDiagram / ...) selects the diagram kind.

src.description: Path to a .mmd file to load the mermaid source from (used when no inline mermaid/text/dsl is given). Consistent with picture/media 'src' = a file path. Alias: path.

x.description: Top-left X of the diagram's box (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default: centred horizontally on the slide. The slide size is never changed (use poster=true for that).

y.description: Top-left Y of the diagram's box (cm/in/pt/EMU). Default: centred vertically on the slide.

width.description: Width of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved (may letterbox against height). Default: the slide content width. Mirrors picture/chart 'width'.

height.description: Height of the box the diagram is scaled to fit (cm/in/pt/EMU). Aspect ratio is preserved. Default: the slide content height.

poster.description: Controls slide growth for a long diagram. UNSET (default) = ADAPTIVE: the diagram fits the current slide, but if fitting would shrink it below readability it auto-grows the slide to the diagram's natural size instead (clamped to PowerPoint's 56in/142.24cm max). true = always grow the slide (export-a-diagram-as-a-slide). false = always fit the current slide even if the result is tiny. Ignored when an explicit x/y/width/height box is given.

render.description: How to render. With DiagramSpec, native/shapes is the default editable Shape+Connector renderer and smartart/native-smartart explicitly creates native editable SmartArt from the same semantic spec. With Mermaid input, auto uses mermaid.js when available and otherwise falls back to native shapes; image forces the browser path.

theme.description: mermaid color theme (image render only): default (light), dark, neutral, forest, base. Baked into the source as frontmatter, so it round-trips in alt-text and a regenerate reproduces it. Ignored by render=native. Uses the ESM mermaid build, loaded from the CDN (a styled diagram currently needs network on render; plain diagrams stay offline-cached).

layout.description: flowchart layout engine (image render only): dagre (default, curved edges) or elk (Eclipse Layout Kernel — orthogonal edge routing, tighter layered placement). elk loads the @mermaid-js/layout-elk ESM package from the CDN. Ignored by render=native.

look.description: visual style (image render only): classic (default) or handDrawn (sketchy rough.js strokes). Baked into the source frontmatter; round-trips in alt-text. Ignored by render=native.

background.description: render background: transparent (default), a #hex, or a CSS color word. Applied at render time (mmdc -b / page background); does not round-trip in alt-text. Values with whitespace/quotes fall back to transparent.
